Definition: properly, to lean forward, i.e. to peer into the distance; by implication, to observe, await
BiblicalUsage: 1) to look out or about, spy, keep watch, observe, watch; 1a)(Qal) to keep watch, spy; 1b) (Piel) to watch, watch closely
